---
title: "Bootstrap the Spack Builder"
subtitle: "Create a pinned Rocky 9 workshop before resolving project software"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

The builder image contains Rocky Linux 9 and a pinned Spack release, but no
project packages. It resolves and installs the final runtime independently of
the cluster's mutable Spack installation.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Bootstrap Tools"}

```sh
command -v quarto
command -v singularity
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-generic file="{{ emit.project_root }}/containers/bootstrap/spack-builder.def" title="Emit The Builder Definition"}

```text
Bootstrap: docker
From: spack/rockylinux9:1.2.0

%environment
export SPACK_ROOT=/opt/spack
export PATH=/opt/spack/bin:${PATH}
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Build The Builder Image"}

```sh
mkdir -p artifacts/containers
singularity build --fakeroot artifacts/containers/spack-builder.sif \
  containers/bootstrap/spack-builder.def
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Builder"}

```sh
singularity exec artifacts/containers/spack-builder.sif spack --version
singularity exec artifacts/containers/spack-builder.sif cat /etc/os-release
```

:::
